summary: Feed s056_single is degraded: 22.7% of frames (420/1849) are truncated to ~128 bytes, preventing full-payload inspection required by the NDR. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted_share, missing_vlan, one_way, oversize, packet_drops, tool_overload, tunnel) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker slicing/snap-length is enabled and cutting packets to 128 bytes before delivery to the tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs_full_payload=true for DPI, protocol parsing and threat detection; truncated payloads hide L7 content, causing missed detections, incomplete flow reassembly and reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Disabling slicing restores full packets so the NDR receives complete payloads as required for detection.
